reference_sql:
WITH product_rev AS (  -- one row per product with 2025 sales
  SELECT category_name, product_id, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY category_name, product_id
),
compared AS (  -- one row per product with 2025 sales
  SELECT category_name, product_id, revenue,
         AVG(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY category_name) AS avg_rev
  FROM product_rev
)
SELECT category_name, product_id, revenue, ROUND(avg_rev, 2) AS category_avg
FROM compared
WHERE revenue > avg_rev
alternatives:
WITH product_rev AS (  -- one row per product with 2025 sales
  SELECT category_name, product_id, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY category_name, product_id
),
category_avg AS (  -- one row per category with 2025 sales
  SELECT category_name, AVG(revenue) AS avg_rev
  FROM product_rev
  GROUP BY category_name
)
SELECT pr.category_name, pr.product_id, pr.revenue, ROUND(ca.avg_rev, 2) AS category_avg
FROM product_rev pr
JOIN category_avg ca ON ca.category_name = pr.category_name
WHERE pr.revenue > ca.avg_rev

SELECT t.category_name, t.product_id, t.revenue, ROUND(t.avg_rev, 2) AS category_avg
FROM (
  -- one row per product with 2025 sales
  SELECT category_name, product_id, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue,
         AVG(SUM(net_revenue_eur)) OVER (PARTITION BY category_name) AS avg_rev
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY category_name, product_id
) AS t
WHERE t.revenue > t.avg_rev

solver.query: WITH r AS (SELECT category_name, product_id, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue FROM sales WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date <= DATE '2025-12-31' GROUP BY 1, 2), a AS (SELECT category_name, product_id, revenue, SUM(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY category_name) AS tot, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY category_name) AS n FROM r) SELECT category_name, product_id, revenue, ROUND(tot / n, 2) AS category_avg FROM a WHERE revenue * n > tot
